message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout, and instead of panicking, I grabbed my trusty lantern and set up a little cozy corner in the living room. We pulled out some snacks and played cards by the soft glow of the light, turning what could have been a hassle into a fun family night. It's amazing how a little creativity can make even a power outage feel like an adventure! How do you keep the mood up during unexpected outages?
